headline: Sobha, Fractal Analytics, Ipca Laboratories and Sagility top technical scan
hook: Four stocks close above volume-weighted average
summary: Shares of Sobha, Fractal Analytics, Ipca Laboratories, and Sagility closed more than 1.5% above their volume-weighted average prices on October 21, according to StockEdge's VWAP scan. VWAP is a technical indicator used by traders to gauge the true average price of a stock based on both volume and price throughout the session. Closing above this level often signals short-term bullish momentum for these equities. Retail investors following technical indicators use this scanner data to identify intraday strength.
why_it_matters: Indicates short-term technical momentum for these four listed stocks.
